newsitem.title: USA: Cinergy to serve Greenwood, S.C..
newsitem.headline: Cinergy to serve Greenwood, S.C..

text.p: Cinergy Corp said Wednesday it has agreed to supply electricity to Greenwood, S.C., for at least the next five years effective June 7.

The company said it was one of several utilities and power marketers that responded to a request for proposals to serve Greenwood's 60-megawatt load. The applicants were narrowed to Cinergy, Southern Co, KU Energy Corp, the Municipal Energy Agency of Georgia, and North Carolina EMC backed by purchases from Enron Corp.
The town, located 70 miles southwest of Columbia, is currently served by Duke Power Co.

Cinergy's statement did not give the terms of its agreement with Greenwood's Commissioners of Public Works, but it did say it made possible a 10 percent across-the-board rate reduction for the system's 12,000 customers.
